maddeler.e:
انتحلت (form VIII)
# اِنْتَحَلْتُ (intaḥaltu) /in.ta.ħal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
# اِنْتَحَلْتَ (intaḥalta) /in.ta.ħal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
# اِنْتَحَلْتِ (intaḥalti) /in.ta.ħal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
# اِنْتَحَلَتْ (intaḥalat) /in.ta.ħa.lat/: third-perso
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
